user_story: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: User successfully logs out from the application
steps: Click on the 'Logout' button on the user dashboard.
positive.expected_result: The user is logged out and redirected to the login page. A message 'Successfully logged out' is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to log out with an expired session
steps: Wait for the session to expire.
Try to log out by clicking the 'Logout' button.
negative.expected_result: The user sees a message indicating that the session has already expired and is redirected to the login page.

edge.title: Log out while multiple sessions are active from different devices
steps: Log in on Device B with the same user credentials.
Verify session status on Device B.
edge.expected_result: The session on Device A is terminated and Device B remains logged in. No error occurs on Device B.
